articles.summary: - Raises Outlook for Full-Year 2026 FFO as Adjusted - Urban Edge Properties (NYSE: UE) (the "Company") today announced its results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 and updated its outlook for full-year 2026. "Our third quarter results reflect the strength of our operating platform and the progress of our capital recycling strategy. Same-property NOI grew 4.5% and new lease cash spreads were 27%, demonstrating the embedded value in our portfolio. FFO as Adjusted of $0.38 per share grew 6% over the prior year," said Jeff Olson, Chairman and CEO. "We also continued to upgrade the portfolio, selling Briarcliff Commons for $60.5 million, acquiring The Shops at West Falls Church for $40.4 million, and, earlier this month, entering Florida with the $90.3 million acquisition of Regency Court in Boca Raton, a market that shares the dense, affluent demographics, high barriers to entry and limited new supply that exists in our D.C. to Boston portfolio.
